data.plainLyric:
What are you doing all the way over there?
Like seriously?
Get over here
Closer, closer, come closer to me (Closer to me)
Closer, closer, stay right here, baby
Just a little closer (Just a little closer), just you and me
Closer, closer, stay close to me
Somethin' about you (Ah, yeah), I just can't get out of my mind (Mind)
This feelings in my heart (In my heart), you ignite
(Ooh-ooh) And when you come close, can't meet your eyes
You make me nervous, but I kinda like it
Take it slowly (-ly), stay close to me (Ooh-ooh)
I can be yours if you'll let me be
No second guessing, I'm feeling you
Maybe, baby, you feel it too
Closer, closer, come closer to me (Closer to me)
Closer, closer, stay right here, baby
Just a little closer (Just a little closer), just you and me
Closer, closer, stay close to me
Whenever I'm with you, time goes so fast (Ooh)
Wishin' somehow this moment could last
Tell me your secrets (Ooh), I'll tell you mine (I'll tell you mine)
And I wanna get to know you more tonight
Closer, closer, come closer to me (Closer to me)
Closer, closer, stay right here, baby
Just a little closer (Just a little closer), just you and me
Closer, closer, stay close to me, yeah
Closer, closer, just a little closer
Closer, closer, stay right here
Stay close to me (Stay right here, baby)
Just a little closer (Just a little closer), just you and me
Closer, closer, stay close to me

{more Gehlee lyrics at lyricsify.com/u/KPopLRCFiles}
